key_insight: SpinQICK enables RFSoC-based control of a fully connected triangular exchange-only qubit, including coherent manipulation, state preparation, and readout.
engineering_relevance: The open-source platform offers a low-cost, flexible route to semiconductor spin-qubit control and hardware optimization through qubit-level noise diagnostics.
method: Build on QICK and Xilinx RFSoC signal generation and digital signal processing.
Apply precise time-domain voltage control to a triangular triple-quantum-dot device.
Implement a geometry-enabled dynamical decoupling sequence to characterize electrical noise.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experimental demonstrations of coherent control, state preparation, and readout, plus verification of the new dynamical decoupling sequence, but provides no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Scalability and quantitative control fidelity are not established by the abstract; the demonstrated decoupling sequence relies on triangular device connectivity.
paper_title: Demonstrating RFSoC-based Control of a Fully Connected Exchange-Only Qubit
